claim: stdio is process-per-user (50 devs x 8 servers ~ 400 processes) with ~0.3-1ms latency and no transport auth; Streamable HTTP serves many clients per process with ~5-10ms latency and Authorization header.
quote: Stdio (warm): ~0.3-1 ms ... Streamable HTTP (same DC): ~5-10 ms ... one server process serves many clients concurrently. Lifecycle decoupled from any specific client.

claim: Cloudflare deploy guide uses Streamable HTTP; migrating from stdio means swapping the HTTP server adapter; auth via X-API-Key or OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.
quote: This guide will show you how to deploy your own remote MCP server on Cloudflare using Streamable HTTP transport, the current MCP specification standard.

claim: Streamable HTTP is JSON-RPC 2.0 over a single endpoint with optional SSE, replacing HTTP+SSE; stdio fits local single-user.
quote: Streamable HTTP (MCP spec 2025-03-26) is JSON-RPC 2.0 over one HTTP endpoint that supports POST and GET, with optional Server-Sent Events for streaming.

claim: Official MCP Registry hosts metadata only (points to npm/PyPI/Docker), uses reverse-DNS namespaces verified via GitHub/DNS, is consumed by aggregators not host apps, does not support private servers.
quote: Package registries - such as npm, PyPI, and Docker Hub - host packages with code and binaries. The MCP Registry hosts metadata that points to those packages.

claim: Free remote hosting options include Cloudflare Workers (100K req/day), Vercel, mcphosting.io, and FastMCP Cloud personal tier; public servers can skip auth, private use API key or OAuth.
quote: Cloudflare Workers (100K requests/day), mcphosting.io, and FastMCP Cloud's personal tier are free indefinitely, not trial periods.

claim: Self-hosting a remote MCP server in your own container behind a load balancer is a valid deployment pattern giving full control.
quote: Host MCP Server: The 2026 Deployment Guide

claim: .mcpb bundles an entire local MCP server and dependencies into a single installable zip, similar to Chrome (.crx) or VS Code (.vsix) extensions, for one-click install.
quote: MCP Bundles (.mcpb) are zip archives containing a local MCP server and a manifest.json ... spiritually similar to Chrome extensions (.crx) or VS Code extensions (.vsix), enabling end users to install local MCP servers with a single click.

claim: Desktop Extensions (.mcpb, renamed from .dxt) bundle the server and deps; manifest.json is the only required file; Claude Desktop bundles Node.js; secrets stored in OS keychain; install by double-click.
quote: Desktop Extensions (.mcpb files) solve these problems by bundling an entire MCP server-including all dependencies-into a single installable package. ... Sensitive configuration like API keys are stored in the OS keychain.

claim: Install the MCPB CLI with npm install -g @anthropic-ai/mcpb, then mcpb init to scaffold manifest.json and mcpb pack to build the .mcpb file.
quote: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/mcpb ... mcpb init ... mcpb pack to create a mcpb file.

claim: VS Code configures MCP in .vscode/mcp.json (workspace) or user profile; supports stdio (command/args) and http (url) types; install via @mcp gallery or code --add-mcp; avoid hardcoding secrets.
quote: HTTP (Remote): "type": "http", "url": ... Stdio (Local): "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", ...]. Avoid hardcoding sensitive information like API keys.

claim: Publishing to the registry: create server.json, add mcp-name to package README, publish package, then mcp-publisher login github and mcp-publisher publish; GitHub MCP Registry will source from the official registry.
quote: ./mcp-publisher login github ... ./mcp-publisher publish path/to/.mcp/server.json ... Other MCP registries, such as the GitHub MCP Registry, will soon use the Official MCP Registry as a source of MCP server listings.

claim: The MCP Registry is a community-driven 'app store for MCP servers' that stores server metadata only, not the actual code.
quote: The registry stores server metadata only-not the actual code.

claim: Each client has a different config file, path, and failure behavior even though server packages are interchangeable across clients.
quote: Each client has a different config file, a different file path, and different behavior when something breaks.

claim: Claude Code adds servers with claude mcp add --transport stdio|http; --scope project writes .mcp.json to commit for teammates; SSE is deprecated in favor of HTTP as of early 2026.
quote: claude mcp add --transport http my-server https://your-server-url ... Use --scope project to write to .mcp.json at the project root ... SSE is deprecated in favour of HTTP transport.

claim: Cursor configures MCP in .cursor/mcp.json and supports 'Add to Cursor' one-click install deeplinks.
Cursor deeplinks use cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=NAME&config=BASE64_CONFIG to install a server without manual JSON editing.
quote: Cursor requires the JSON configuration to be Base64 encoded with the format: cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=$NAME&config=$BASE64_CONFIG.
